description: Research-only quant API, evidence store and replay services.

interfaces.auth: write routes use the owner write boundary; read routes use the existing API contract

external_dependencies: PostgreSQL quant schema with Alembic lineage
provider credentials supplied by the owner host

commands.dashboard: cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build

release_unit_notes.edge-quant-console: quant 控制台（frontend/）的静态资源发布单元。源码归本组件，运行位置在 47edge —— 适配器同源代理两个 SPA，所以它必须和飞书面板同源。由 scripts/edge/deploy-quant-console-edge.sh 独立发布到 hotfix/quant-console/，与 feishu-relay 的发布目录互不覆盖。
